notes.title: Linelith Level Design Timeline
notes.content:
I've created an interactive timeline of the level design iteration during the development of Linelith! You can view the level design at 32 points in time, plus annotations and additional information.

[url=https://cwpat.me/misc/linelith-level-design-timeline/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315875/557a2bc1cdfb9df6e81427c449d44ef9b9d2cfcf.gif[/img][/url]

I put together this timeline because I thought it would be interesting to see the three world structures I made before settling on the fourth and final one. I hope it's interesting and/or useful to you! :)

View the timeline here: [url=https://cwpat.me/misc/linelith-level-design-timeline/]https://cwpat.me/misc/linelith-level-design-timeline/[/url]

notes.title: Fix startup crash
notes.content:
This patch should hopefully fix a crash, which occurred only for some people, on the second startup of the game, if you had enabled the fullscreen setting during your first game session.

Sorry if this bug prevented you from playing. And if you're still experiencing issues after this update, I'd appreciate a report with details. Thanks.

notes.title: Linelith released!
notes.content:
Linelith has just been released! Excited to see people enjoy this short and sweet game; I'm very happy with how it turned out! :)

Linelith was discovered and developed as part of the CosmOS 9 Bundle: a collection of 9 short puzzle games, found on a video game console drifting in space. Definitely consider picking up the bundle, and receive Linelith as a part of it!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25434/CosmOS_9/

notes.title: Puzzle game collection CosmOS 9 is a gentle introduction to the genre
notes.content:
A new collection of indie puzzle games released today aims to give a broad and gentle introduction to many puzzling subgenres. Wrapped up in that idea that they're all pulled from a mysterious alien games console, CosmOS 9 packs nine games that are each meant to take 30-90 minutes. I've played a few and they seemed puzzle game staples, having me drawing paths through blocks, figure out how a mysterious computer interface worked, and such. See the breadth of the cosmic puzzling experience in the trailer below.
